name: print-social-geometric-tulip-poster-with-heavy-grotesque
title: Tulip built from two shapes in hot pink with giant black grotesque title
whatItIs: A pale pink poster in a black frame. A giant black 'Flower' fills the top, a rule sits beneath, then a huge tulip made of overlapping rounded pink shapes with a lime green stem crossing the text below. Small body copy sits in columns.
whatItMeans: Bold, playful and modernist; simple shapes say flower without any detail.
techniques: Reduce a subject to two or three flat overlapping shapes.
Set the title in an ultra-heavy face across the full width.
Let the stem overlap body text for depth.
Use hairline rules to organise the grid.
bestFor: Poster series and posters with a single symbol

vocabulary.definition: Simplifying an object into basic geometric forms.
Shapes placed over each other in different tints.
